verdict.rationale: New Relic explicitly documents native OpenTelemetry ingestion ('Instrument your service with OpenTelemetry and gain platform-agnostic observability' and 'By integrating OpenTelemetry with New Relic, you can leverage a wide range of platform capabilities') which supports OTel-based instrumentation that could in principle move between backends. But the evidence pack has no independent confirmation that switching away from New Relic is friction-free, and most of New Relic's own tooling (NRQL, dashboards, alerts, CLI) is proprietary to its platform, implying some lock-in beyond raw OTel data. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of backend portability, clarity on which features work only with New Relic-specific instrumentation vs pure OTel.
